key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >1%) are gastrointestinal: flatulence (4.6% vs 0% placebo), diarrhea (4% vs 1.7%), constipation (4% vs 0.8%), feces discolored (4% vs 0.8%), and abdominal pain (2.9% vs 2.5%). 4.6% of ACCRUFER patients discontinued treatment due to adverse reactions.
